summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  **What I'd do, in order:**  1. **Re-verify the audit before writing any code.** I had a sub-agent trace the full path (schema → handlers → auth middleware → client fetch → cookie issuance), and it came back clean: every watchlist route requires a valid session, scopes reads/writes to `user_id`, the client always sends `credentials: "include"`, and there's no localStorage/anonymous-watchlist fallback in the client. That's the opposite of what the ticket assumes (a wiring bug). Before touching code I'd confirm this isn't a stale/in
